newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India GDRs fall in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India GDRs fall in thin trade.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts fell on Monday following losses in local markets, but volume was thin and there was very little selling pressure, traders said.
"Stocks aren't under pressure, I'm being shown nothing," one trader said.
"Its really just drifting to find a level of interest," he said.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 4.22 points lower at 84.22, a 4.77 percent fall, with the premium over the local market at 17.63 percent from 20.56 percent.
Bombay's benchmark index shed 96.96 points to 4,225.02 as a political row within the ruling government coalition weighed down shares.
Telco fell 92 cents to $14.35/$15.35 and State Bank of India slumped 97 cents to $25.37/$26.12.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index was 0.54 points firmer at 77.43 points, a premium of 45.57 percent over the local market.
Taiwan GDRs enjoyed a strong trading day after shares in the local market hit a seven-year high.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 4.82 points higher at 139.07, representing a discount to the local market of 1.20 percent.
